name: JV_CI_GROUP_LINES_
description: This table contains the consenting and non-consenting stakeholders in a carried interest agreement and the percent of carried interest for each stakeholder in the stakeholder group.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder group associated with a carried interest agreement.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder group associated with a carried interest agreement.

columns.name: NON_CONSENTING_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is a non-consenting partner in the carried interest agreement.

columns.name: CONSENTING_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is the consenting partner assuming the share for the non-consenting partner.

columns.name: CARRIED_INTEREST_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The percent of interest that the consenting stakeholder is assuming for the non-consenting stakeholder.

columns.name: CREATE_JOURNALS_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether carried interest journals are created for carried interest distributions for the consenting stakeholder.

columns.name: DEFAULT_CI_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the default carried interest account used when creating a carried interest journal.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
